+name: BlueskyUIHarness
+options:
+  bundleIdPrefix: com.example
+settings:
+  base:
+    SWIFT_VERSION: 5.0
+    IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: 17.0
+    CODE_SIGN_STYLE: Automatic
+targets:
+  HarnessApp:
+    type: application
+    platform: iOS
+    sources:

+        GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
+    scheme:
+      testTargets:
+        - HarnessUITests
+  HarnessUITests:
+    type: bundle.ui-testing
+    platform: iOS
+    sources:
+      - path: HarnessUITests
+    dependencies:
+      - target: HarnessApp
+    settings:
+      base:
+        PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.example.HarnessUITests
+        GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
+schemes:
+  BlueskyUIHarness:
+    build:
+      targets:
+        HarnessApp: all
+    test:
+      targets:
+        - HarnessUITests
*** Add File: bluesky_ui_harness/HarnessApp/BlueskyUIHarnessApp.swift
+import SwiftUI
+
+@main
+struct BlueskyUIHarnessApp: App {
+    var body: some Scene {
+        WindowGroup {
+            Text("Harness")
+        }
+    }
+}
*** Add File: bluesky_ui_harness/HarnessUITests/BlueskyUITests.swift
+import XCTest
+
+final class BlueskyUITests: XCTestCase {
+    func testDumpHomeScreenAccessibility() {
+        let springboard = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "com.apple.springboard")
+        let bluesky = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "xyz.blueskyweb.app")
+
+        if springboard.alerts.buttons["Open"].waitForExistence(timeout: 10) {
+            springboard.alerts.buttons["Open"].tap()
+        }
+
+        XCTAssertTrue(bluesky.staticTexts["What's up?"].waitForExistence(timeout: 20))
+
+        let buttonLabels = bluesky.buttons.allElementsBoundByIndex.map { $0.label }
+        let textLabels = bluesky.staticTexts.allElementsBoundByIndex.map { $0.label }
+        let fieldLabels = bluesky.textFields.allElementsBoundByIndex.map { $0.label }
+        let textViewLabels = bluesky.textViews.allElementsBoundByIndex.map { $0.label }
+
+        print("BUTTONS: \(buttonLabels)")
+        print("STATIC: \(textLabels)")
+        print("FIELDS: \(fieldLabels)")
+        print("TEXTVIEWS: \(textViewLabels)")
+    }
+}
